name: delivery-meeple-distinct-colours-v1
description: ⭐ C112: THE DELIVERY MEEPLE WITH NO PER-TURN CAP AND NO TWO OF THE SAME COLOUR IN ONE TURN. rules.turn.meepleSpendPerTurn is null, which means UNLIMITED, and rules.turn.meepleSpendDistinctColours is true. Everything else matches the rule as ruled: rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1 (a random meeple on every tile's 3 VP space, index 1 and never index 0) and rules.turn.meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction' (M4, discard one to take the PLAIN action of its colour, the meeple then leaving the game). ⛔ ITS CONTROL AND ITS PAIRED ARM IS overlays/delivery-meeple-v1.overlay.json AND THE TWO DIFFER IN EXACTLY TWO LEAVES, the cap and the colour rule, which are the two halves of one question and cannot be split further. Its second control, further back, is overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1.overlay.json, whose twenty leaves are all pinned here by name. ⛔ C100 IS STILL OPEN AND NO NOTICE BOARD ARM IS RULED IN AS THE SHIPPED GAME: the shipped default is rules.turn.visitCurrency 'commons', so THIS IS AN ARM ON TOP OF AN ARM, and here an arm on an arm on an arm since its pairing is against another unruled arm. Every report header quoting it must say so. ⛔ WHY IT EXISTS, AND IT IS A TABLE FINDING BEING MEASURED RATHER THAN DISCARDED. Dean ruled one meeple per turn (M5) on a branching concern raised by the manager, and THE CONCERN SHRANK WHEN IT WAS MEASURED: at about 1.8 meeples a player a game, 'as many as you like' almost never means more than two, so the explosion barely exists here. Meanwhile the combo burst is precisely the thing Dean's own table enjoyed on 11/09/2026, when he reported that the meeple allowed some fun, powerful combos. A table finding discarded on a manager's say-so is worth less than a run, and this arm is that run. ⭐ WHY THE COLOUR RULE RATHER THAN NO RULE AT ALL: it keeps a ceiling on the burst (five colours, so five spends at the absolute outside) and it makes the burst a matter of what you COLLECTED rather than how many you happened to hold, which is the part of the island decision the meeple exists to create. ⛔ IT IS A SECOND LEAF AND NOT A MAGIC VALUE OF THE CAP. 'No two of the same colour' is not expressible as an integer, so rules.turn.meepleSpendPerTurn keeps meaning HOW MANY and rules.turn.meepleSpendDistinctColours says WHICH ONES MAY BE COMBINED. Re-pointing one leaf at a rule of a different shape would redefine a published quantity underneath its own readings, which this project has paid for twice: a17 judged on plays per turn (09/09/2026) and the meeple cap that shipped as a passenger (05/09/2026). ⚠️ THE FIRST NUMBER TO READ IS ACTIONS PER TURN, which passes at only 1.61 against a target of 1.5 under the control and to which every meeple spent adds an action. THIS IS THE LOOSER OF THE TWO RULES, so it is the arm most likely to break that target. Read meeples spent per turn, the distribution of how many were spent at once, meeples stranded at game end and the colour mix beside it. ⛔ AND RUN THE BRANCHING BENCH, because the cap was adopted to protect against exactly this. Quote both move populations and seconds per game beside them (C99); a 116,535-move position stopped this project on 02/09/2026 and an 888,030-move one on 05/09/2026. If the bench moves materially here, Dean's cap was right for the reason he gave, and that is a finding rather than a failure. ⭐ THE BUILDER DEFAULTS THIS ARM CARRIES, NAMED RATHER THAN DISCOVERED. D7 ⭐ RULED BY DEAN, 12/09/2026: THE MEEPLE SPEND IS LEGAL ON ANY TURN ONCE THE ACTION WINDOW HAS CLOSED, whether the main action was taken or passed. D8: the meeple's plain action IS subject to the standing rule that an action you cannot legally perform is not offered, so A MEEPLE CAN BE UNDISCARDABLE, which matters more here than in the capped arm because an undiscardable colour also blocks nothing else in a multi-spend turn. ⚠️ D1 to D6 have no subject because there is no coin, and D9 has no subject either; the chaining question is C111 and only overlays/village-store-coins-and-meeple-v1.overlay.json can answer it. ⛔ THE COLOUR MAPPING IS M7 AND IT IS GROW AND NOT SOW: wheat Harvest, vegetable Deliver, orchard Draw 2 keep both, apiary GROW, dairy Build; and it is THE PLAIN ACTION AND NEVER THE NOTICE BOARD POWER (M6), the Orchard board being Draw 4 where the plain action is Draw 2. M8 rides too: a meeple Grow places its activation card as normal and CAN clog. ⛔ WHAT MAY NOT BE QUOTED OFF THIS ARM. (1) THE BONUS RATE IS A SHARE OF TURNS AND NEVER PLAYS PER TURN; judging the band on plays cost this project a re-run of five arms on 09/09/2026, and the bonus slot at four seats has one tenth of a point of headroom under the control. (2) NO LEVEL HERE IS COMPARABLE WITH A reference-v14 OR EARLIER NUMBER; only a delta paired on identical seeds against a named control is sound. (3) THE BARN GLUT READS +0.5 IDENTICALLY ACROSS THIS WHOLE FAMILY ON BYTE-IDENTICAL PER-SEAT LINES, so read the per-seat rows and NEVER the pooled median. (4) The hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S bound (C7) and the table plays with none. (5) ⛔ AND THE THING C112 IS ACTUALLY ABOUT CANNOT BE MEASURED AT ALL: whether a burst of combined meeples is FUN. The simulator can price the actions and count the branching; it cannot see what Dean saw on 11/09/2026, and no bot has ever held a meeple back for a turn to combine it. Read this arm for cost, and take the pleasure question back to a table. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME. THIRTY LEAVES. The control's twenty, unchanged and in its own order: rules.turn.visitCurrency, bonusTiming, selfVisitAllowed, hostDrawOnVisit, commonsTake, startingMeeplesPerColour, meepleAsCard, slotToll, meepleCapPerColour; rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold, noticeBoardBlocks, unclaimedBoardsToCentre, noticeBoardsBySeats.2, .3 and .4, commonsColourMatch, commonsWildPair, endgameCoinCost, farmsteadCoinPower; and rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisitBySeats.4. ⛔ rules.turn.startingMeeplesPerColour STAYS 0 AND rules.turn.meepleAsCard STAYS false: this arm's meeples come from the island and nowhere else, which is the whole difference between it and the economy a table rejected on 09/09/2026, and it matters doubly here because an uncapped spend plus a starting stock is the ambient bonus that died. Then the six coin leaves pinned OFF (rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard 0, coinSupplyPerPlayer 0, coinPaysBuild, coinPaysSuitCost, coinPaysGrow and coinGrowOnFullBuilding all false), and the four meeple leaves: deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn null and meepleSpendDistinctColours true. ⚠️ ON deliveryMeepleSpace's null: it does NOT mean 'no meeples', it means defer to the existing meeplesPerTile seeding, so pinning it to 1 is a real change. ⚠️ ON meepleSpendPerTurn's null: it means unlimited and it is also the SHIPPED value, so this leaf is pinned here as a statement of intent rather than as a change, and the arm's whole difference from its control is carried by the colour leaf plus the removal of the cap. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against overlays/delivery-meeple-v1.overlay.json on identical seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. ⚠️ AS OF COMMIT e5aea08 ALL TEN NEW LEAVES ARE INERT: they exist in the data layer and no branch of play reads them yet, so this arm currently measures identically to both of its controls. A run before the engine slices land proves the file parses and validates, and nothing else.
